# Cuis-Website

The website of Cuis Smalltalk, published at [cuis.st](https://cuis.st) with GitHub Pages.

It is a Jekyll site without a theme:

* Layouts: `_layouts/`, and the header, footer and lists they share: `_includes/`
* Styles: `assets/main.scss`
* Pages: `_pages/`
* News: `_posts/`
* Meeting recordings: `_data/pastMeetings.yml`
* Packages: `_data/packages.yml`, plus `_data/github.yaml`, generated by `_data/extract-github.lisp`

## Run and develop

GitHub Pages builds the site with the versions listed at [pages.github.com/versions](https://pages.github.com/versions/) (Ruby 3.3.4, `github-pages` 232). To run it locally with the same versions, use Docker:

```
docker compose up
```

The site is served at http://localhost:4000 and rebuilds on every change.

Without Docker, with Ruby 3.3.4 installed:

```
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
```
